name: Tube Squeezer
description: A bar with a narrow slot that the flat end of a toothpaste, lotion, paint or glue tube feeds through, then slides along the tube to press out the last of it. The slot is sized from the tube's flattened width, with rounded ends that won't cut the folds; closed, or open at one end to slip onto a half-used tube. Grip wings with finger grooves, and an optional inlaid label. Prints flat without supports.
source: inspired by the tube squeezer template in vibe-print (Hunter Stradley, MIT)
